name: Daoya Farm No. 3
summary: A 2 ha LED-lit growth hall of wheat and soybean. Lights run 16 hours of each sol; air temperature and CO2 enrichment follow them, and the crop's growth follows the light and the CO2.

kpis.label: Biomass growth
kpis.note: design is the sol average: 26 kg/h for the 16 lit hours

since_note: Terminus was built from 2156 to 2158 as a farming city.
story: Terminus City was designed as a farming city. Daoya, founded there, runs farms in Isidis and Hellas and sells improved crops to the nearest Martian cities.
process: Photoperiod of 16 h at 600 umol/m2/s, LEDs at about 3 umol/J
CO2 enrichment to 1,200 ppm when lit, 800 ppm in the dark
Air temperature 24 degC lit, 18 degC dark
Biomass growth about 0.6 g of dry matter per mol of photons

sources.label: System development and early biological tests in NASA's Biomass Production Chamber (NASA)
Bugbee and Salisbury 1988, Exploring the limits of crop productivity, Plant Physiology 88
Kusuma, Pattison and Bugbee 2020, From physics to fixtures to food: LED efficacy, Horticulture Research 7
